description: This file defines the MigrationAPI class within the OrangeHRM Installer module. The class extends an existing MigrationAPI to provide API functionalities related to database migrations, specifically handling GET requests to retrieve migration mappings.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: A class handling migration-related API requests within the installer, extending functionality from a base MigrationAPI.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the API, returning the keys of the MIGRATIONS_MAP which represent available migration identifiers.
